Abstract.AbstractText: Dealing with a growing older adult patient population, keeping pace with current guidelines, and adhering to new recommendations is a perpetual endeavor for healthcare professionals. Because determining the best access for individual patients is not always obvious, vascular access is a challenging aspect of patient care. This article presents information on the ever-evolving and improving world of vascular access, specifically synthetic grafts.
